# Task m3-05-bank
Experience bank: build once from resume text, load, save, check, add skills.

Export:
- bankPath(), skillsExtraPath(), resumeTextPath(): paths under the profile dir
  (bank.yaml, skills-extra.yaml, original/resume.txt).
- loadBank(): Bank | null; saveBank(b: Bank); loadSkillsExtra(): SkillsExtra
  (empty list if missing); saveSkillsExtra(s).
- async buildBank(): reads resume.txt, prompt = fill(one-time-parser template,
  { "paste text": text }) + "\n" + JSON_NOTE, calls generate with model
  process.env.JOBOPS_PARSE_MODEL ?? "qwen2.5:14b", schema BankSchema.omit({ approved, meta }),
  timeoutMs 900000. Refuses (throws) if bank.yaml exists and approved is true.
  On success saves with approved: false and meta. Returns { ok, issues }.
- checkBank(b: Bank, resumeText: string): string[] issues, each "<bullet-id>: <problem>":
  every number in a bullet (regex /\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?%?/g) must appear in resumeText;
  bullet ids unique and prefixed by their entry id; short has at most 15 words;
  tags count 5..8. Issues never include bullet text.
- addSkill(name, status, evidence): lowercases name, replaces an existing entry
  of the same name, saves.
- vocabulary(b: Bank, extra: SkillsExtra): Set<string> of lowercase terms from
  all skills lists, all bullet tags, and extra skills with status "have".
why: Coder invented b.entries / b.skills[i].name and missed .ts imports

# Task m3-03-model-provider
A minimal model provider for local Ollama.

Export:
  type GenerateResult<T> = { ok: true; value: T; model: string; durationMs: number }
                         | { ok: false; error: "timeout" | "unavailable" | "invalid_output"; detail: string }
  async function generate<T>(opts: { model: string; prompt: string; schema: z.ZodType<T>;
    timeoutMs?: number (default 300000); baseUrl?: string (default
    process.env.OLLAMA_URL ?? "http://localhost:11434") }): Promise<GenerateResult<T>>

Behaviour:
- POST {baseUrl}/api/chat with { model, stream: false, messages: [{ role: "user",
  content: prompt }], format: z.toJSONSchema(schema), options: { temperature: 0 } }.
- Use fetch with AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs). Abort → "timeout". Connection
  error or non-2xx → "unavailable" (detail = status or message).
- JSON.parse the message.content, then schema.safeParse. On failure retry once
  with the same request; if still invalid → "invalid_output" (detail = first
  3 issue paths, never the content).
- Never throw for these cases; return the error result.

# Task m3-10-score
Deterministic scoring of the bank (or a resume record) against requirements.

export type Label = "supported" | "partial" | "not_demonstrated" | "unknown"
export function scoreRequirements(req: Requirements, bank: Bank, extra: SkillsExtra,
  only?: string[] /* bullet ids to consider; default all */): ScoreResult
ScoreResult = { score: number (0..100, one decimal); gap: boolean;
  items: array of { requirement: string; kind: "must" | "nice" | "keyword"; label: Label;
    bullet_ids: string[] }; ask_user: string[] }
Rules, with vocab = vocabulary(bank, extra) and bullets = considered bullets:
- For each requirement r: rt = terms(r, vocab).
  supported: some bullet has a tag in rt, or norm(r) appears in a bullet text, or
    rt is non-empty and every term in rt is an extra skill with status have.
  partial: rt is non-empty and at least one term is in a bank skills list or in
    some bullet tag, but not supported.
  not_demonstrated: rt is empty and norm(r) looks like a skill (at most 3 words,
    no verb from: build, own, lead, drive, work, collaborate, design).
  unknown: otherwise.
  bullet_ids = ids of bullets whose tags intersect rt or whose text contains norm(r).
- score = 60 * mustCov + 20 * niceCov + 20 * kwCov, where cov = (supported +
  0.5 * partial) / count, and an empty list counts as 1.
- gap = any must item labeled not_demonstrated.
- ask_user = keywords and must/nice items labeled not_demonstrated whose
  norm() is not in extra with status dont_have; unique, sorted.
export async function scoreJob(db: Db, jobId: string): uses loadRequirements,
  loadBank, loadSkillsExtra; returns { job_id, score, gap, supported, partial,
  missing, ask_user } (counts, not items).
why: Needs bank, requirements, and terms modules it never saw

# Task m3-16-risk
Rejection-risk check: why a resume that scores well might still be rejected.
Deterministic, no model call. Each risk becomes a question for the user.

export type Risk = { id: string; kind: "must_have" | "years" | "senior_signal" |
  "impact" | "keywords" | "title_level"; detail: string; question: string }
export function riskCheck(req: Requirements, bank: Bank, extra: SkillsExtra,
  selected: string[] /* bullet ids */): Risk[]
Rules (selected bullets = bank bullets whose id is in selected):
- must_have: each must item labeled not_demonstrated by scoreRequirements →
  id "must:<norm(item)>", question "The JD needs <item>. Have you used it? Where?"
- years: largest N found by /(\d+)\s*\+?\s*(?:years|yrs)/i in must_have items;
  total years = sum over roles of (end - start) parsed from dates like
  "Jan 2021 - Present", "2019 - 2022", "03/2020 – 06/2023" (Present = now;
  unparseable dates are skipped). If total < N → id "years", question
  "The JD asks for <N>+ years; your listed roles add up to <total>. Any earlier
  experience that counts?"
- senior_signal: for each theme in req.themes matching one of leadership,
  mentoring, ownership, architecture, scale, cross-team (norm, substring), if no
  selected bullet has that word in its tags → id "theme:<word>", question
  "The JD values <word>. Give one example where you showed it."
- impact: if fewer than half the selected bullets have impact "high", one risk
  per selected bullet with impact low → id "impact:<bullet-id>", question
  "Bullet <bullet-id> has no measurable result. What changed (latency, cost, users, revenue)?"
- keywords: kwCov from scoreRequirements over selected below 0.6 → id
  "keywords", question listing the missing keywords: "Have or don't have: <a, b, c>?"
- title_level: req.seniority or req.role contains staff, sde 3, sde iii, lead,
  or principal, and the first role title contains none of senior, staff,
  lead, principal, sde 3, sde iii → id "title-level", question "This role is
  above your latest title. Did you work at that level (owned a system, led a
  team)? Give one example."
- Drop risks whose id is in extra.dismissed (see m3-17). Never put bullet
  text in detail or question; ids and JD words only.

# Task m3-04-prompts
Load the user's prompt templates from disk and fill placeholders.

- Directory: process.env.JOBOPS_PROMPTS_DIR ?? "requierements".
- export function loadPrompt(name: "one-time-parser" | "parse-job-descripton" |
  "select-and-tailor"): { template: string; version: string }
  version = first 8 hex chars of sha256 of the file content (node:crypto).
- export function fill(template: string, values: Record<string, string>): string
  replaces each "[key]" literally (e.g. "[paste text]", "[paste JD]",
  "[list your variants]", "[paste Prompt 2 JSON]", "[paste shortlist]", "[N]",
  "[M]", "[25]"). Throw if a given key is not found in the template.
- export const JSON_NOTE = "Return the result as JSON with exactly this structure." 
  (appended by callers to the YAML prompt, because output is forced to JSON).
why: Coder read requirements/*.txt and threw on brackets
Coder did not export schemas; Zod v4 usage
